entry.question:
## Physical scenario

Figure shows the probability density for an electron that has passed through an experimental apparatus.

## Question

What is the probability that the electron will land in a \( 0.010\text{-mm} \)-wide strip at \( x = 0.000\text{ mm} \)?

## Answer choices

- A: A: \( 3.0 \times 10^{-4} \)

- B: B: \( 3.0 \times 10^{-3} \)

- C: C: \( 5.0 \times 10^{-3} \)

- D: D: \( 5.0 \times 10^{-4} \)

## Figure caption (auxiliary; use the image as primary evidence)

The image is a plot labeled \(P(x) = |\psi(x)|^2 \, (\text{mm}^{-1})\). The x-axis is labeled as \(x \, (\text{mm})\) and ranges from \(-3\) to \(3\). The graph consists of triangular peaks centered at \(x = -2, 0, \text{ and } 2\).

- At \(x = -2\), and \(x = 2\), the triangles peak at 0.25 on the y-axis.
- At \(x = 0\), the triangle peaks at 0.50 on the y-axis.
- The lines forming the triangles create a symmetric pattern around the y-axis, with each triangle having a base width of about 2 units on the x-axis.

Overall, the plot is symmetrical with three evenly spaced triangular peaks.
